facts.activity_file: setting and proving mechanical seal support systems
facts.activity_series: maintaining sealing systems on rotating equipment

control_failures.control_label: integrity of the mechanical seal support system

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: audit finding - permit to work records incomplete for ZV-7210

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system had degraded below its design intent, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the integrity of the mechanical seal support system on ZV-7210 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining sealing systems on rotating equipment, specifically setting and proving mechanical seal support systems. ZV-7210 (emergency shutdown valves) is in service for jetty and manifold emergency isolation. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the integrity of the mechanical seal support system had degraded below its design intent. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 13 January 2018 a planned critical control verification of ZV-7210 at Cape Verity Export Terminal found the integrity of the mechanical seal support system not effective.
